description:
Yoroll — Playable Videos. Living Characters. Infinite Worlds.
Scroll like video. Play like a game.
Watch stories. Talk to characters. Change the story. Play the world.
Yoroll is where stories stop being something you just watch — and become something you can step into.
Scroll through interactive videos, make choices that change what happens next, talk directly with characters, and explore worlds that respond to you.

Watch stories.
Discover interactive dramas, adventures, mysteries, romance, survival, and more. Swipe in and start playing in seconds.

Talk to characters.
Meet characters you love, talk to them directly, and keep the story going beyond the screen. Every conversation can take your relationship somewhere new.

Change the story.
Your choices, conversations, and actions can change what happens next. Take a different path, discover new possibilities, and make the story your own.

Play the world.
Go beyond watching and choosing. Step into interactive worlds where you can explore, act, and shape what happens around you.
Some stories take only minutes. Others keep unfolding as you play.
There’s always another story to discover, another character to meet, and another world to step into.

Don’t just watch the story. Play your way into it.
Need help or have feedback?
Reach us at support@yoroll.ai
